summary: Frontend-only verification of the Specialty Item Engine on /scope-calculator (owner) and ghost sales POV, plus a Settings sanity check. All 11 scripted scenarios pass: derived pricing-mode indicator flips Household ↔ Specialty-only correctly, custom items card exposes every documented data-testid, Sub-Zero 500–799 built-in+swap on stairs shows cap note ('Handling capped at 30% of labor …'), forces crew=4 with the 4-man floor note that cannot be reduced by crew-minus, renders the owner-only market-sanity card (OK line for 'Appliance, swap / multi-unit'), and yields a range quote of $975–$1,075 (well under $2,150). Width 42 / narrowest 34 replaces the quote with scope-blocker-card ('is wider than the narrowest point…') and disables scope-mode-final; path=48 restores the quote. Band 800+ shows scope-custom-800-note and blocker card; changing back restores quote. Needs-disconnect toggle renders scope-custom-disconnect-note. Save→reload persists name/band/builtIn/swap correctly (label $800–$900 shown in list). Household regression (rooms + Upright piano + stairs) shows Household mode, no cap note, no sanity card, range $1,375–$1,550. Ghost sales sees no price build (no cap note, no sanity, no $ figures on the custom row) and a range quote. Owner Settings page contains the new 'Custom specialty items' group with all 8 keys (surchargeCustomB1–4, customBuiltInMultiplier, customDisconnectMultiplier, customSwapFactor, specialtyHandlingCapPct). No JS errors on any page (401s in console are Airtable/ledger endpoints missing keys — expected and out of scope).
critical_code_review_comments: ScopeCalculator.jsx is >1000 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (RoomsCard, CustomItemsCard, PriceBuild, SanityCard) for maintainability.
Room density chips (—/Light/Avg/Packed) lack data-testids; had to rely on aria-pressed + role selectors. Adding testids like scope-room-{k}-tier-{i} would harden future automation.
Saved-scopes list has no inline delete/rename control visible to the tester; TEST_ scopes accumulate in preview. Consider an owner-only trash icon per row for cleanup.

Could not delete via UI — no inline delete control on saved-scopes rows. Non-blocking; safe to leave or main agent can prune from DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All specialty engine acceptance criteria verified live in preview at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reusable Playwright flow: login → /scope-calculator → scope-clear-btn → scope-jobtype-labor → scope-custom-add-btn → fill name/band/checkboxes → stairs via aria-label 'More Flights of stairs — pickup/drop-off'. Room density chips need to be selected via `page.locator('div.grid').filter(has=page.get_by_role('button', name=<room>, exact=True)).locator('button', has_text='Avg')`. Only one older saved scope exists in preview (our own TEST_specialty) — main agent can seed a pre-custom scope if backward-compat regression on legacy scopes needs re-testing later. Airtable/ledger 401s in console are expected (no AIRTABLE_API_KEY in preview).
